label: Beamsplitter plate (50:50)
tooltip: Non-polarizing beamsplitter plate; place at 45 deg AOI. The front (-x) face carries the beamsplitter coating (default bs_5050_vis_45 -- swap the 'coating' property for any bs_XXYY_vis_45 registry row to change the split ratio). wedge_deg tilts the back face slightly to kill parallel-plate etalon fringes (0 = plane-parallel).
